snippet.title: Fail Games — Official Trailer | One Button. Endless Failure.
snippet.description:
FAIL GAMES is a brutally difficult collection of one-button physics minigames where winning can take 100 attempts—and every failure makes you richer.

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4888210/FAIL_GAMES/

Wishlist on Mobile:
https://croc.fish/failgames

Created by a solo developer, FAIL GAMES combines fast five-second challenges, ridiculous ragdoll physics, retro C64-inspired pixel art, and instant restarts. Every game is simple to understand. Actually beating one is another matter.

🎮 ONE BUTTON. ENDLESS FAILURE.

Hold. Release. Hope.

Jump from cliffs, clear spinning saw blades, survive ski jumps, dodge seagulls, and attempt perfect landings while unpredictable wind and obstacles ruin everything.

🏆 WIN TO UNLOCK THE NEXT GAME

Beat a minigame once to unlock the next challenge. Then things get harder, stranger, and significantly more... mean.

💰 FAILURE PAYS

Every failed attempt earns coins. Spend them on outfits, visual effects, skins, crowns, high heels, blood, and other completely essential performance-enhancing cosmetics.

📊 COMPETE WITH YOUR FRIENDS

Climb the global leaderboards, unlock achievements, and prove that you can fail slightly more successfully than everyone else.

FAIL GAMES features:

• 50+ handcrafted one-button minigames
• Extremely simple controls
• Brutally difficult physics-based gameplay
• Runs lasting only a few seconds
• Instant restarts with no waiting
• Funny ragdoll crashes and spectacular failures
• Unlockable outfits, effects, and skins
• Global leaderboards and achievements
• Retro C64-inspired pixel art
• Seagulls with absolutely no respect for personal space

It’s so easy to learn your grandma could play it—but so hard to master you’ll throw your PC out the window.

And your grandma.

Would you play FAIL GAMES? Tell me in the comments which challenge would break you first.

#FailGames #IndieGame #PixelArt
